title: Spacey Jane kick off their homecoming run at Brisbane's Riverstage tonight
body:
Spacey Jane's Heading Back Down Under tour starts tonight with the first of two nights at Brisbane's Riverstage, followed by a second show on Friday.

The Perth band then head south for back-to-back nights at Melbourne's Sidney Myer Music Bowl on 4 and 5 December. It caps a big year that included the AIR Breakthrough Independent Artist of the Year award.

title: DMA'S play three exclusive shows, starting in Brisbane on Friday
body:
DMA'S are playing just three Australian headline shows behind their new self-titled album, and the first is this Friday at Brisbane's Fortitude Music Hall.

Melbourne's Royal Botanic Gardens follows on Saturday, before a Sydney homecoming on the Opera House forecourt steps on Thursday 3 December.

title: Guns N' Roses start their Australian stadium run in Adelaide this Sunday
body:
Guns N' Roses open their Australian tour this Sunday, 29 November, at the bp Adelaide Grand Final, then head to Townsville's Queensland Country Bank Stadium on 2 December.

The run continues to Brisbane (5 December), Newcastle (8 December) and Melbourne. Check the promoter's site for remaining tickets.

title: Gracie Abrams books six arena nights for 2027, with Arlo Parks in support
body:
Gracie Abrams is coming back in July and August 2027 for three nights at Melbourne's Rod Laver Arena and three at Sydney's Afterpay Arena, touring her third album, Daughter from Hell.

Arlo Parks joins as special guest. General tickets went on sale on Friday 20 November.

title: Zach Bryan announces his first Australian headline tour
body:
Zach Bryan will play his first Australian headline shows in December 2027: two nights each at Melbourne's Marvel Stadium, Sydney's Accor Stadium and Brisbane's Suncorp Stadium.

Vance Joy and Emma Ogier are on the bill. His last Australian show, in 2023, sold out in minutes.

title: Golden Plains 2027: Geese and Underworld top the bill at Meredith
body:
Golden Plains returns to the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre from 6 to 8 March 2027, with Geese and Underworld headlining.

The line-up also includes Tinariwen, Peter Garrett & The Alter Egos and Miss Kaninna. See our Golden Plains guide for the full bill.

title: Powderfinger confirm their reunion tour, 17 years on
body:
All five members of Powderfinger are back for a national tour from September to October 2027, played inside a travelling big top. It starts at Brisbane Showgrounds and finishes at Melbourne Park Oval, with Cairns, Perth, Sydney and Adelaide in between.

Extra shows have already been added, and the band are picking an all-Australian line-up of support acts.

title: Laneway 2027: Fontaines D.C. and Hayley Williams lead the line-up
body:
Laneway Festival's 2027 line-up is out, led by Fontaines D.C. and The Hayley Williams Show, with Slayyyter, ADÉLA, Kim Petras, MUNA and Ninajirachi also on the bill.

It's a smaller run this time: Sydney, Brisbane and Melbourne in February, with no Adelaide or Perth shows. Fontaines D.C. are playing their own headline shows in Perth and Adelaide instead. Our Laneway guide has all the details.
